summary: Regression sweep after AuthProvider useMemo wrap in /app/frontend/src/lib/auth.jsx. Backend: 39/39 pytest tests PASS (auth 24 + github/projects 15) in 10.6s. Frontend: all 5 requested UI flows PASS - (1) login page renders with login-google-button/login-submit-button/login-email-input/login-password-input, (2) unauthenticated visits to /dashboard, /settings, /connect, /repos, /projects/:id all redirect to /, (3) authed /dashboard renders dashboard-connect-cta (seeded user has no github_connection, expected), (4) /settings shows settings-profile-card + settings-password-card and settings-profile-email matches the seeded email exactly, (5) user-menu-trigger -> user-menu-logout clears session and a subsequent /dashboard redirects to /. Zero AuthProvider/useAuth/context console errors. useMemo change is transparent to consumers (Login, Dashboard, Settings, ProtectedRoute, AppShell, UserMenu all read { user, setUser, loading, refresh, logout } correctly).

issues: Carried over from iteration_3 (NOT re-tested here since seeded user has no projects): nested <a><a> hydration warning in ProjectCard (react-router <Link> wraps a project-card-live-url-{id} <a>). Non-blocking. This is not related to the AuthProvider change.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.jsx useMemo change is correct: deps [user, loading, refresh, logout] cover all mutable values; setUser is stable from React (no need to include). Consumers see a referentially stable value across unrelated re-renders, which is the intended perf micro-fix.

If future iterations touch auth.jsx again, re-verify: (a) useAuth() still returns { user, setUser, loading, refresh, logout }, (b) Login/Dashboard/Settings/ProtectedRoute/UserMenu still consume it, (c) no console errors mentioning 'AuthProvider' or 'useAuth'.
